newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan January bad cheque rate drops to 0.55 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan January bad cheque rate drops to 0.55 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's bad cheque ratio fell to 0.55 percent in January from 0.63 percent in December, the central bank said in a statement on Friday.
Bad cheques made up 0.35 percent of the total value of all cheques written, down from 0.42 percent in December, the statement said.
The total number of bad cheques was down 10.40 percent from December while the value of bad cheques decreased a month-on-month 14.69 percent, it said.

The central bank gave no reason for the falls. But various economic data released recently by the government have shown that Taiwan's relatively sluggish recovery had picked up steam in the fourth quarter of 1996 and in January.
